title: THE FLIGHT LOG
intro: First solo to CFI in 42 months, with internships in airfield design, UAS survey, and business aviation along the way.

entries.title: Soloed My First Three Students
entries.text: Three primary students sent on their first solo flights in a single month, each within 10 hours of my instruction. One of my top milestones.

entries.title: Hult Prize US Nationals
entries.text: One of 34 teams from 15,000 worldwide, and one of the first two Nebraska teams ever, competing at the University of Arizona, April 17-18.

entries.title: Student Entrepreneur Award
entries.text: UNL Center for Entrepreneurship Student Entrepreneur Award, robotics engineering major, PROTO, College of Engineering.

entries.title: Raikes Startup Studio + $100K Investment
entries.text: PROTO earned a spot in the Raikes School Startup Studio for 2026-27 and a $100K investment from Invest Nebraska.

entries.title: Innovative Learning Conference
entries.text: San Francisco with the Nebraska Center for Entrepreneurship, learning from leaders at Apple, Meta, Visa, and Stanford HAI, plus a visit with Stanford engineering students.

entries.title: Managing Director
entries.text: Leading aircraft marketing, brokering, closeout, and acquisitions for a brokerage team with over 50 years of combined experience, evolved from building their web platform.

entries.title: Flight Technical Programs Intern
entries.text: Designed and validated instrument procedures in business-jet simulators; built digital ops tooling for flight technical teams.

entries.title: Civil Air Patrol Instructor Pilot
entries.text: Instructing CAP aircrew toward Air Force Assigned Missions in Cessna 182 & 172 aircraft.

entries.title: Certified Flight Instructor
entries.text: Earned the FAA Flight Instructor Certificate, the privilege of teaching people how to fly.

entries.title: Commercial Pilot Certificate
entries.text: FAA Commercial Pilot Certificate, Airplane Single Engine Land.

entries.title: Airfield Design Intern
entries.text: Supported DOD and FAA airfield programs; streamlined CAD workflows across civil design disciplines.

entries.title: Founded PROTO Robotics
entries.text: President & CEO, leading a 40-member student team across hardware, software, curriculum, design, and outreach to make engineering an adventure for elementary-age kids.

entries.title: UAS / Survey Intern
entries.text: LiDAR and photogrammetry missions for infrastructure projects; survey-grade deliverables from field to office.

entries.title: Seaplane Rating
entries.text: FAA Airplane Single Engine Sea rating.

entries.title: Private Pilot Certificate
entries.text: FAA Private Pilot Certificate, Airplane Single Engine Land.

entries.title: First Solo
entries.text: First solo flight in an airplane. Where it all started.
